summary: Aya Gold & Silver furnished a 6-K containing a press release reporting drill results and newly secured exploration permits at its Boumadine silver-gold project in Morocco. Highlights include intercepts such as 269 g/t AgEq over 11.9 m and 239 g/t AgEq over 17.0 m along the Main Trend, plus three additional permits expanding the project area to 357 km2. Year-to-date drilling of 181,685 m surpassed the 2026 target two months early. No transaction, ownership change, or capital event is disclosed; this is routine exploration disclosure with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
